name: szass tam
lore:
Szass Tam is a wound in the world that refuses to heal. As a lich of ancient vintage, his ecology is one of pure stagnation; he exists beyond the cycle of breath and decay, sustained by the rhythmic consumption of souls and the cold hum of the Weave. He does not inhabit the land so much as he leeches from it, transforming the once-fertile Thay into a grim reliquary of dust and perpetual winter.

Behaviorally, Tam is the personification of patient malice. He does not rage; he calculates. To him, the living are merely raw materials—ephemeral sparks to be snuffed or harnessed for his grand, necromantic architecture. He views time not as a river, but as a chessboard where he has already foreseen every gambit. To encounter him is to face an intellect so vast and frigid that the grave, by comparison, seems welcoming.
